entities.summary: Li Chunsheng was a Taiwanese businessman and philosopher active during Qing and Japanese era. born in Xiamen, Fujian, he moved to Dadaocheng, Taipei, Taiwan in 1868. He possessed good business managing skills and was highly influential in Taiwan in his time.
